## Confirmed defect and original contract

The [refinement task](POLISH-1-REFINEMENTS.md) and [full-batch R1 brief](POLISH-1-OS2-REVIEW-R1.md), especially criterion5, require full accessible exit information for each refused attempt, including repeated attempts and batches, while avoiding redundant visible text. `stepGame` emits both refusals correctly. `SiltwakeApp.events` synchronously delivers them to GameView; HudView's zero-delay live-region callback cancels the earlier callback on a new result, leaving only one full refusal in the accessible delivery stream.

Sol reproduction: `/tmp/siltwake-os2-sol-r1/announcement-batch-probe.mjs`, fixture `view-fixture.mjs`, raw JSON/log in the same directory. Root copied/adapted them into `/tmp/siltwake-os2-review-root/`, replacing worktree imports and output path. Root logs: `announcement-batch-probe-red.log` and JSON. Do not run original scripts in place because they write into their evidence directories. Copy/adapt to your own directory.

The test uses a diagnostic stationary Dart atY−80 with the60m suit and empty-water query. This is nevertheless a real missing composition case in the promised UI event contract. ## Reconciled delivery behavior

Do not merely satisfy the review probe with rapid writes that overwrite one another before the browser can expose the messages. A **single atomic live-region update containing the pending full refusal messages in arrival order** is allowed and preferred over a delayed speech queue; repeated attempts must retain their occurrences. Separate later attempts still cause a fresh clear/set announcement. Tests should assert delivered content, occurrence count/order and lifecycle, not require one particular number of DOM assignments. This clarifies delivery shape without waiving the original per-attempt full-information requirement.

Keep any accumulation transient to the pending scheduling turn and current valid exit context. One scheduled flush suffices; do not add a time-delayed backlog, persistence, generic notification queue, extra visible subtitle, hazard duplication, focus move or simulation work. Re-rendering the same result must not add entries or reannounce delivered entries. Keep ordinary singleton and generic-action behavior as before. Changed actor/exit reason, successful exit, menu/panel, explicit clear, reset/New/import/Continue/replacement and dispose invalidate obsolete pending content and scheduled writes. Current full guidance may update depth values within a reason; retain the original event text for each actual attempt. A generic action replacing exit feedback should not later resurrect a stale exit message. An unmatched refusal still provides its full fallback. Full live-region content remains text, not HTML.

Preserve the concise visible `Exit blocked` result, exact current full guidance, existing active-time expiry, panel-local full messages, successful `Left the craft`, and separate hazard/persistence routing. Do not change quiet/boost/surface movement, damage rounding, controls or any accepted visual design. A small private helper/state field inside HudView is within ownership; return its exact reset/disposal semantics for root inspection.
